sloka: यो ऽसौ गजस्कन्धगतो महात्मा नवोदितार्कोपमताम्रवक्त्रः ।प्रकम्पयन्नागशिरो ऽभ्युपैति ह्यकम्पनं त्वेनमवेहि राजन् ।। ६.५९.१४ ।।।।
transliteration: yo 'sau gajaskandhagato mahātmā navoditārkopamatāmravaktraḥ ।prakampayannāgaśiro 'bhyupaiti hyakampanaṁ tvenamavehi rājan ।। 6.59.14 ।।।।

translations.english: "O King! the one seated on the elephant, by whose weight the elephant head is shaking, whose coppery face is like the rising sun, a gigantic one is Akampana."
